tools.name: bridge_create_ask
tools.description: Create a bridged elicitation ask. Requires account_token. Trial and plan-included asks run here; paid asks collect over the HTTP x402 surface.

tools.name: bridge_poll
tools.description: Poll a bridged ask for its era-shaped result (account token + ask token + session binding required; same operator-isolation gate as the HTTP poll).

tools.name: bridge_unsupported_error
tools.description: The per-era unsupported-ask error this product replaces (-32601 for 2025 eras, -32021 for 2026-07).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "bridge_poll" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Poll a bridged ask for its era-shaped result (ask token required)." → after: "Poll a bridged ask for its era-shaped result (account token + ask token + session binding required; same operator-isolation gate as the HTTP poll)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
